exchanges: ok so today was one of those days where everything went sideways from like 7am, the drywall delivery came to the wrong address and then the inspector showed up an hour early at the bergstrom job and i wasnt even there yet
That's a rough start on two fronts. Did the inspection go ahead without you?
wojciech handled it thank god hes my foreman and hes been doing this for 30 years so inspectors kind of love him, it passed
Having a foreman like that is gold. A pass on a bad morning is a real win.
totally. although hes not doing great physically, hes been walking hunched over all week and finally admitted its sciatica flaring up again, he refuses to take time off though
That's a painful thing to work through on a job site. Maybe you can keep him on supervision rather than lifting for a while.
yeah ive been trying, he hates being told what to do lol. anyway the bergstrom job is the kitchen and two bathrooms for annika bergstrom and her husband, theyre nice but very particular
Particular clients can be good, they usually know what they want. What are they being particular about?
everything but mostly the counters, annika has looked at like forty samples and finally landed on quartz, a white one with grey veining, it took three showroom visits
Three showroom visits is commitment. At least that's low maintenance for a busy kitchen.
right and heres the fun part, her sister liv bought the house two doors down and now wants us to do her kitchen too right after, so i get to do this all over again
That's great for business, even if it means more showroom trips. Is Liv as particular?
worse lol, she wants marble even though i told her it stains like crazy, she says she doesnt care she wants the real thing
Some people really do love how natural stone ages. As long as she's been warned, it's her call.
yeah ive warned her in writing so
Smart, that protects you if she's unhappy later.
ok other news, kofi our plumber told me hes retiring at the end of the year, hes moving back to ghana, to accra where his family is, im happy for him but losing him is going to hurt
That's a big loss for your crew, but what a great way to retire. Do you have someone in mind to replace him?
not yet, good plumbers are impossible to find right now, everyone is booked six months out
Starting the search now is a good idea then. Maybe Kofi knows someone he'd recommend.
good idea ill ask him tomorrow
He'd probably love to help pick his successor.
so then the drywall finally showed up at like 1 and paolo our electrician was waiting on it to finish roughing in so he lost half a day and was grumpy about it
Delivery delays ripple through everyone's schedule. Can he make it up later this week?
probably saturday, he doesnt mind weekends as long as i pay him time and a half
That's fair. Budget it in and the schedule stays on track.
ugh fine. ill eat that cost i guess, the supplier screwed up so maybe i can get a credit from them
Definitely worth asking. Wrong-address deliveries are on them.
ok im home now finally, eating cold pizza on the couch
The classic end of a long day. You've earned it.
lol yeah. oh and i was wrong about kofi earlier, i was looking at the card he gave me, its kumasi not accra, thats where his family actually is, accra is just where he flies into
Good catch. Sounds like he's put a lot of thought into the move.
he has, hes been building a house there for like five years
That's a long-term plan finally coming together. He must be excited.
very, he showed me pictures, its huge
Retiring into a house you built yourself sounds pretty great.
ok tomorrow i need to go back to the bergstrom house and figure out the tile for the bathrooms which is going to be another forty sample situation
Maybe bring a narrower set this time. Three or four options can stop the endless browsing.
honestly yeah ill pick three and make them choose
That's a good strategy for indecisive clients.
also ive got the new apprentice starting monday, mateo, hes 19 and super keen
Keen apprentices are fun to train. Will he be with Wojciech?
yeah wojciech will take him under his wing, mateo is doing his trade school through humber so hell be on site 3 days a week and in class the rest
That's a good balance of classroom and real work. Wojciech has a lot to teach him.
yeah hopefully some patience too lol
Patience is the hardest skill to teach, but a good mentor helps.
ok going to bed, early start again
Good night, I hope tomorrow is smoother.

questions.message: what did annikas sister want for her kitchen again
where is kofi going to live once he retires
annika picked marble in the end didnt she
where is mateo doing his classes
does paolo have any plans for where hes retiring to
my alarm is set for 5:30 which feels illegal
